summary: P0#4 field-name fix VERIFIED end-to-end. `dm-notify-context.tsx` now reads `c.last?.created_at || c.updated_at || <legacy fallbacks>` and both the single-prompt and group-prompt re-arm flows work as designed. Single: seed maggie → prompt shows 'Margaret sent you a private message' + Chats badge appears → tap 'Not now' → prompt hides, badge stays → seed a SECOND maggie DM → prompt RE-APPEARS within the 15s poll cycle. Group: with maggie already unread, seed joycey → group prompt 'You have 2 new private chats' shows → dismiss → seed frankie (3rd sender) → group prompt RE-APPEARS as 'You have 3 new private chats' within the poll cycle. Regression: 'View chats' on the group prompt correctly navigates to /chats which lists all 3 unread conversations (Frank/Joyce/Margaret) with per-conv unread counts. No new backend calls, no console errors from this feature, tab bar layout unchanged, chats-tab-unread badge integer keeps its own live count. Fix is complete.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix reads `c.last?.created_at || c.updated_at || c.last_message?.created_at || c.last_message_at || ''` in both `_pick_prompt` single-case (line ~133-138) and group-reduce (line ~156-161) — the canonical backend contract (server.py:8544 emits `last`, server.py:9142 bumps `updated_at` on every incoming DM) is the primary key source, and the legacy `last_message*` fallback is retained purely defensively. This matches the ask exactly.

Dismiss-set key composition (`single:${convId}:${messageTs}` / `group:${newestTs}:${count}`) unchanged; because `messageTs`/`newestTs` now truthfully reflect the newest inbound message, a fresh DM automatically produces a NEW key and the previously-dismissed entry becomes irrelevant. No LRU tuning needed — housekeeping trim at 100 entries is fine.
The provider re-computes `prompt` when `convs` changes (poll cycle), when `viewingConvId` changes (path nav), and when the dismissed-version bumps — all three still hold with the fix.
No changes to `GlobalDmPrompt.tsx`, `(tabs)/_layout.tsx`, or the backend — the fix is a 2-line frontend patch as advertised.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 7/7 checks pass (T1a single show, T1a badge, T1a dismiss, T1b single re-arm, T2a group show, T2b group re-arm count=3, Reg1 group Open→/chats)

rca_of_issue: N/A — verifying a fix, no new bug. Prior iteration_100 RCA was: `dm-notify-context.tsx` was reading `c.last_message?.created_at || c.last_message_at` but the backend `/api/dm/{uid}/conversations` returns `last` (not `last_message`) with no `last_message_at`, so `messageTs`/`newestTs` were always empty string → dismissed-set key stable → re-arm broken. Main agent's 2-line patch now reads `c.last?.created_at || c.updated_at` first (which the backend DOES emit and bumps on every incoming DM at server.py:9142), so the key changes on every new inbound message and the prompt reliably re-arms. Verified with 4 seeded scenarios end-to-end.
